thread:
maria_pm: Quick proposal — add a 6-week 'compat grace' window for pinned tenants when we onboard new catalog models. Bench gate + canary plan included.

eric_eng: Can you paste the short plan? trying to parse in triage.

maria_pm: TL;DR: onboard -> canary (10%) -> expand (2w) -> full rollout. Pin grace: pinned tenants get opt-in 6 weeks where we won’t auto-swap their pinned version; we provide migration assistance + metrics.

sophia_research: For the bench gate we should require: latency p95 <= 1.2x current pinned, semantic accuracy >= baseline on onramp suite, and hallucination regression <= 2% absolute.

sam_ops: Ops concerns: we need an explicit rollback path and capacity budget for additional QPS during canary. If canary fails, auto-fallback to previous variant and create incident. @maria_pm can you add the rollback SLA?

alex_sales: Heads-up: a couple large customers asked for 90-day pin guarantees. 6 weeks might be tight for contracts but works as default if we offer paid extended pin.

maria_pm: Noted. We can make 6 weeks default + paid 90-day opt-in. Add to customer terms doc.

sophia_research: Bench config (draft):
```
bench_suite: onramp_core_v2
metrics: [semantic_f1, rouge, latency_p95, hallucination_rate]
seq_len: 512
sample_size: 1k
pass_thresholds: {semantic_f1: 0.80, hallucination_rate: <=0.05}
```
this will be part of the acceptance gate.

eric_eng: Canary traffic plan: 10% for 24-48h -> 30% for 3-7d -> 100% after 2w if no regressions. Autoscale/bolster memory for higher KV cache. Auto-fallback hook: `fallback_to: pinned-vX` with hot rollback (<5m).

sam_ops: Also add a capacity reserve flag on Dedicated pools during canary: `reserve=+15%` to avoid noisy neighbor fallout.

alex_sales: For customers asking 90-day, we’ll include migration support: dedicated SE time + a rollback window in contract. Happy to coordinate comms.

catalog-bot: model "llama-lite-2.1" added to staging catalog (meta: bench_needed=true).

sophia_research: Add hallucination probes: targeted adversarial prompts + real-customer prompt samples where available. Must log diff vs pinned.

maria_pm: Final checklist to land in PR: bench results attached, canary policy config, rollback hooks, customer opt-in flag, comms draft. I'll open a tracking ticket after this thread. :white_check_mark:

eric_eng: SGTM. Will prototype the canary feature flags this week. :thumbsup:

sam_ops: I'll draft the ops playbook and rollback runbook.

alex_sales: I'll start customer comm templates and outreach plan.

maria_pm: Thanks team — will file the ticket and tag everyone. Follow-ups in the ticket thread.
